instructions: Drain the tuna very well and transfer it to a medium bowl. Break it up with a fork.

Juice the limes into a small bowl. That should be about 1/4 cup. Dice the tomato. Cut the jalapeno open, scrape out the seeds and ribs, and mince it. Chop the cilantro until you have about 1/4 cup. Dice half the cucumber and a quarter of the red onion. Slice the avocados.
Add the tomato, jalapeno, cilantro, cucumber, onion, salt and the lime juice to the tuna. Stir until combined.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Spread about 2 tbsp of refried beans over each tostada shell. Lift the tuna mixture with a slotted spoon so the extra juice stays in the bowl, and pile it on top.
Top with the avocado slices. Serve right away, 2 tostadas each.
method_notes: Lead is Mama Maggie's Kitchen tostada de atun (5 from 3 ratings): drained canned tuna mixed with lime, tomato, jalapeno, cilantro, cucumber and onion, piled on refried-bean tostadas with avocado. Maricruz Avalos (no rating) makes a creamy chipotle and mayo version, and Salima's Kitchen (no reviews) fries the shells and skips the mayo, so cooks differ on creamy or lime-based; the lime version is the one with no stove. Queso fresco is left out to keep it dairy-free, and the lead's 1/2 cup lime juice is cut to 1/4 cup. Assemble at the table so the shells stay crisp.
